title: INTERVIEW-2: Adaptive interview: model picks the next question
body:
**Owner:** Product manager
**Trigger:** see below
**Done check:** grep:site/worker.js::adaptiveQuestion
**Status:** closed

Replace the static question bank with a small model choosing the next either/or question from answers so far; record which questions narrowed the solution space most. Trigger: model credential bound and 20 stored profile:* rows. Closing probe: median questions-to-build below 4 in the stored profiles.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 221.7 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
